_meta.description: Known-answer test vectors for EIP-4844 KZG operations.

vectors.name: all_zero_blob
vectors.blob_pattern: all zero bytes (4096 zero field elements)
vectors.note: Polynomial commitment of the zero polynomial is the identity element in G1, serialized as 0xc0 followed by 47 zero bytes (BLS12-381 compressed infinity point).

vectors.name: single_one_at_index_0
vectors.source: Self-consistency: hand-constructed input, expected output computed by github.com/crate-crypto/go-kzg-4844 v1.1.0 ContextSecure (Ethereum trusted setup ceremony).
vectors.blob_pattern: blob[31] = 0x01, all other bytes zero (one field element of value 1 at evaluation point 0, others zero)
vectors.note: Cross-checks precompile path against direct library call; commitment_hex is computed dynamically and compared with library output to detect divergence between the precompile and the reference library.

vectors.name: modulus_field_element
vectors.source: EIP-4844 / consensus-specs validate_blob — BLS_MODULUS = 0x73eda753299d7d483339d80809a1d80553bda402fffe5bfeffffffff00000001 (BLS12-381 scalar field r)
vectors.note: Field element equal to r MUST be rejected as non-canonical (DeserializeBlob -> ErrNonCanonicalScalar). Silent modular reduction would be consensus-splitting.

vectors.name: modulus_plus_one_field_element
vectors.note: Field element > r must also be rejected.
